rule: Recovered = F1_val >= F1_val(original) - 0.03. Among the QAT runs that recover F1, take the highest LCI_val. Gap (explanation-specific, room for a new method) iff that LCI_val <= 0.85 (uniform per-channel 4-bit PTQ is 0.90 on fold 0, so <= 0.85 = at least 0.05 below it). No gap iff it is > 0.85 (a standard recipe fixes 2 bits). If no run recovers F1: inconclusive for explanations, 2 bits is an accuracy problem first. Fixed before the run; nothing is retuned.
